build_TransposeLast_module: build a PyTorch nn.Module that transposes the last two dimensions of an input tensor
create_TransposeLast_with_deconstruct: create a TransposeLast module with a deconstruct_idx to index into a tuple before transposing
run_TransposeLast_forward: run the TransposeLast forward pass on a tensor to transpose its last two dimensions
review_TransposeLast_init: review the TransposeLast __init__ to understand deconstruct_idx and tranpose_dim parameters
summarize_TransposeLast_class: summarize the TransposeLast class that transposes dimensions and optionally deconstructs tuple inputs
